title: Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays

translated_title: 哪些贷款，而非多少笔：已部署风险模型的精确水平不变、随时有效的监控
translated_abstract: 再融资浪潮可以在不改变评分与提前还款之间关系的前提下，改变抵押贷款提前还款的数量。在逻辑斯蒂模型中，以每月计数为条件，可以将截距从“哪些贷款提前还款”的似然中消除。我们的固定起点斜率乘积用于检验校准斜率的下界；在阈值为20时，其在原假设下曾经越界的概率至多为5%。重启的水平和方法用于跟踪对截距容差的偏离。置信序列用于估计恒定的斜率，而重启-交集规则则检测该斜率发生的变化。连续混合分布避免了离散先验带来的网格外宽度下限问题。在Freddie Mac贷款数据上，固定斜率重采样在开发集中重现了维持模型月度AUC方差的78%，在留出集中重现了70%（95%区间分别为57–100%和48–100%）。从全新的留出集起点出发，重启的水平和方法在两条路径上均发生越界，而固定起点的斜率乘积则保持……
tldr: 本文提出一种精确水平不变且随时有效（anytime-valid）的已部署风险模型校准监控方法，通过以月度计数条件化消除截距影响，从而将贷款数量的变化（如再融资浪潮）与评分-结果关系本身的变化区分开来。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes exactly level-invariant, anytime-valid monitoring of deployed risk models that, by conditioning on monthly counts to eliminate intercept effects, distinguishes changes in loan counts (e.g., refinancing waves) from genuine changes in the score-outcome relationship.
